facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Totems: global cooldown 1.0 s (was 1.5 s), persistent buff totems last 5 minutes (was 2), a tracker lets you right-click a totem to dismiss it, Resistance Totems cover the whole raid group, Tranquil Air Totem is gone, and Fire Nova Totem became a Fire Nova spell that erupts at your Fire totem.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Windfury and Flametongue Totems are now buffs, not weapon enchants, and can't both be active; a Shaman with the matching imbue gets nothing from the totem. Since 16 Oct, Grace of Air no longer conflicts with them, and Grace of Air, Strength of Earth, Windfury and Flametongue Totems reach the whole raid.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Call of the Elements drops a saved set of totems. Call of the Spirits and Call of the Ancestors add more sets. Totemic Recall refunds 25% of totem mana. Totemic Call, formerly Totemic Projection, moves totems to your own position every 30 seconds.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Weapon imbues last 60 minutes and stack with weapon enhancements. Chain Lightning casts in 2.5 seconds and its primary target takes about 145% of comparable Lightning Bolt base damage for about 225% of the mana cost. Higher ranks of Lightning Bolt hit harder, and shock damage returns to Classic Era values.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Call of Thunder replaces Lava Burst and adds 5% crit to Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning. Elemental Mastery is now Lightning Mastery, and Lightning Overload has a 10%, 20% or 30% trigger chance.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Tanking: Blizzard only says Enhancement can be a temporary tank in small groups, through Spirit Weapons and Improved Stormstrike. No raid-tank role has been announced.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Stormstrike deals 150% normalized weapon damage on a six-second cooldown, and Maelstrom Weapon triggers twice as often. Riptide is a heal over time with a 12-second cooldown and roughly 40% lower mana cost.
facts.note: The 10 November talent data lists Stormstrike at 100% weapon damage with an 8 sec cooldown.

facts.label: Talent data
facts.value: Compared with Classic, the Enhancement tree no longer has Shield Specialization, Enhancing Totems, Two-Handed Axes and Maces, Improved Weapon Totems or Weapon Mastery.

facts.label: Talent data
facts.value: Compared with Classic, the Restoration tree no longer has Nature's Guidance or Totemic Mastery.

facts.label: Earth totem quest (Teo Hammerstorm, Anvilmar) (4)
facts.value: Starts in Anvilmar, Dun Morogh. Rewards Earth Totem and Stoneskin Totem (Warcraft Tavern).

facts.label: Fire totem quest (Bruegs Kindleborn, Braldir Ashmantle) (10)
facts.value: Runs from Dun Morogh to Loch Modan. Rewards Fire Totem and Searing Totem (Warcraft Tavern).

facts.label: Water totem quest (Norric Lochthane, Loch Modan) (20)
facts.value: The longest chain, about 2 hours through Wetlands, Redridge, Ashenvale and Westfall. Rewards Water Totem and Healing Stream Totem (Warcraft Tavern).

facts.label: Air totem quest (Veyric, Arathi Highlands) (30)
facts.value: A short trip to Arathi Highlands that rewards Air Totem (Warcraft Tavern). The Classic totem quests used the same levels: 4, 10, 20 and 30.

facts.label: Launch raids
facts.value: Raid unlock date: 9 December 2026, for Barrow Deeps (10 players), Hyjal Summit (20) and Onyxia's Lair (40).

facts.label: Call of Thunder
facts.value: Replaces Lava Burst and adds 5% critical strike chance to Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning.

facts.label: Lightning Mastery
facts.value: Blizzard renamed Elemental Mastery to Lightning Mastery. The October build used the capstone for lightning casts, but Lava Burst was removed in November.

facts.label: Crit damage
facts.value: Elemental Fury raises the critical strike damage bonus of your Searing and Magma Totems and your Fire, Frost and Nature spells: 20% with one point, up to 100% with all five. It requires Lightning Overload.

facts.label: Chain Lightning
facts.value: A 2.5-second cast with about 145% of comparable Lightning Bolt base damage to the primary target and about 225% of its mana cost.

facts.label: Mana
facts.value: Water Shield (Restoration) returns mana when you are hit or, since 16 Oct, when your spells crit.

facts.label: Spell hit (Classic baseline for the cap)
facts.value: Tidal Focus (Restoration) adds hit (1% at rank 1) and the Dwarf racial Artisan's Precision adds 1%. Classic casters needed 16% against raid bosses three levels higher; Forever's cap is not known yet.

facts.label: Raid-wide buff totems
facts.value: Grace of Air, Strength of Earth, Windfury and Flametongue Totems are raid-wide since the 16 Oct notes.

facts.label: Raid-wide totem range
facts.note: Blizzard has not said how far raid-wide totems reach; only Paladin resistance auras state 30 yards.

facts.label: No Bloodlust
facts.value: No raid-wide Bloodlust or Heroism has been announced, and Warcraft Tavern says Shamans don't get Bloodlust in Forever.

facts.label: Resistance totems
facts.value: Resistance Totems cover the whole raid group, which helps on Onyxia, where Blizzard asks raids to build fire resistance.

facts.label: World buffs
facts.value: Wowhead's Forever data marks Rallying Cry of the Dragonslayer 'No effect while in a raid instance', and warcraft.wiki.gg says world buffs are removed in dungeons and raids.

facts.label: Classic caster kit
facts.value: Flask of Supreme Power, Greater Arcane Elixir, Major Mana Potion, Mageblood Potion, wizard oils, Demonic and Dark Runes, Runn Tum Tuber Surprise, Nightfin Soup and Sagefish Delight.

facts.label: Imbues with oils
facts.value: Weapon imbues last 60 minutes and stack with temporary enchants such as wizard oil.

facts.label: New Forever elixirs
facts.value: Warcraft Tavern reports Minor Arcane Elixir and Elixir of Cunning (Agility plus Intellect), with flasks brewed at a portable Alchemy Laboratory camp object.

facts.label: Flasks
facts.value: In Classic only one flask is active at a time, and it persists through death.

facts.label: Stormstrike
facts.value: The strike deals 150% normalized weapon damage and has a six-second cooldown.
facts.note: The 10 November talent data lists 100% weapon damage and an 8 sec cooldown instead.

facts.label: Maelstrom Weapon
facts.value: Melee hits build toward a fast Lightning Bolt. Blizzard doubled the chance for Maelstrom Weapon to trigger.

facts.label: Attack speed
facts.value: Flurry now gives 6%, 12%, 18%, 24% or 30% attack speed after a melee crit.

facts.label: Intellect into power
facts.value: Mental Dexterity converts 50%, 100% or 150% of Intellect into Attack Power.
facts.note: The 10 November talent data lists 33%, 66% and 100%.

facts.label: Elemental Devastation
facts.value: Elemental Devastation: critical strikes with direct damage spells raise your melee crit chance by 3%, 6% or 9% for 10 sec.

facts.label: Melee hit cap vs raid bosses
facts.note: No Forever value has been published. Tidal Focus (Restoration) and the Dwarf racial Artisan's Precision add hit.

facts.label: Windfury and Flametongue Totems
facts.value: Buffs that can't both be active, raid-wide since 16 Oct; a Shaman with the matching imbue gets nothing from the totem.

facts.label: Threat
facts.value: Spirit Weapons reduces the threat from your attacks by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is not active and increases it by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is active.

facts.label: Temporary tank
facts.value: Blizzard only says Enhancement can tank small groups for a while through Spirit Weapons and Improved Stormstrike; Warcraft Tavern doubts current talents are enough for endgame tanking.

facts.label: Personal burst
facts.value: Blizzard made Rage of the Farseer a personal cooldown on purpose rather than a party or raid effect.

facts.label: Classic melee kit
facts.value: Elixir of the Giants, Elixir of the Mongoose, Juju Might, Juju Power, Winterfall Firewater, R.O.I.D.S., Free Action Potion, Grilled Squid and Elemental Sharpening Stone (from a Classic melee guide).

facts.label: Stones with imbues
facts.value: Shaman weapon imbues stack with sharpening stones and weightstones.

facts.label: New Forever elixir
facts.value: Warcraft Tavern reports a new Elixir of the Grizzly (Strength plus crit).

facts.label: Camp buffs
facts.value: Warcraft Tavern: profession camp objects give slightly weaker copies of class buffs that don't stack with the real ones; sit at the camp for at least 1 minute.

facts.label: Riptide
facts.value: A heal over time with no initial heal. The cooldown is 12 seconds and its mana cost is roughly 40% lower than in the October beta.

facts.label: Healing Wave
facts.value: Improved Healing Wave shortens Healing Wave's cast by 0.1 sec per rank, up to 0.5 sec at rank 5.

facts.label: Water Shield
facts.value: 11-point talent: returns mana when you are hit or, since 16 Oct, when one of your spells crits.

facts.label: Regen while casting
facts.value: Mindfulness lets 17%, 33% or 50% of your mana regeneration continue while casting.

facts.label: Crit
facts.value: Tidal Mastery raises the critical effect chance of your healing spells by 1% per rank, up to 5%.
facts.note: A healing crit also triggers Water Shield and Ancestral Healing.

facts.label: Totemic Call
facts.value: Moves your totems to your current position on a 30-second cooldown. Elemental Reach no longer reduces that cooldown.

facts.label: Mana Tide Totem
facts.value: 16-point talent with ranks at 25, 38, 48 and 58.

facts.label: Alliance Shamans
facts.value: Dwarf Shaman is one of Forever's new race and class combinations, so Alliance raids can bring Shaman totems and Mana Tide.

facts.label: Sturdy healer
facts.value: Blizzard calls Shamans among the sturdiest classes, with mail armor and a shield.

facts.label: Raid-wide buff totems
facts.value: Grace of Air, Strength of Earth, Windfury and Flametongue Totems reach the whole raid since 16 Oct; Windfury and Flametongue can't both be active.

facts.label: Reincarnation
facts.value: Improved Reincarnation cuts Reincarnation's cooldown by 10 or 20 min, raises your maximum health by 2% or 4%, and adds 10% or 20% to the health and mana you come back with.

facts.label: Classic baseline
facts.value: Shamans were Horde-only in Classic, so Alliance raids never had Shaman totems.

facts.label: Classic healer kit
facts.value: Flask of Distilled Wisdom, Elixir of the Sages, Major Mana Potion, Mageblood Potion, Demonic and Dark Runes, Nightfin Soup, Sagefish Delight and wizard oils (from a Classic healer guide).

facts.label: Forever alchemy
facts.value: Warcraft Tavern says healing potions moved from Alchemy to First Aid.

facts.label: Imbues with oils
facts.value: Weapon imbues last 60 minutes and stack with wizard oil.
